_note: Canonical authority registry (improvement 2). Merges name variants so the citation graph doesn't split one authority into several (e.g. Seetaram 'SOUTHCO' vs 'Southern Electricity Supply Co.'), and links authorities to corpus records via docid. 'aliases' are lowercase substrings; the first alias that appears in a (lowercased) authority name wins. docid, where present, is the Indian Kanoon id (also used to draw in-corpus edges).
